output.reason: [ev-07d67e9be26a] lists this as a "Pre Upgrade check" in the 0.16 guide. If the kubectl check reports "NOT SAFE! REMOVE v1alpha1 FROM YOUR STORED VERSIONS", the operator must remove v1alpha1 from storedVersions and persist that status before continuing, so this is a mandatory operator step (migration-required). The rendered diffs show v1alpha1 removed from spec.versions of the externalsecrets, secretstores and clustersecretstores CRDs in 0.16.0 [ev-4a1f27e04efd][ev-04b0055709ca][ev-f978a29a8906], which supports the "no longer served" reason; for clusterexternalsecrets the evidence only shows v1 being added [ev-1061f4fcca14]. Nothing in the evidence says the upgrade itself fails, so migration-required with high severity fits better than upgrade-blocked.
